article.title: Attachment before judgment not to affect rights of strangers, nor bar decree-holder from applying for sale.
article.content: Attachment before judgment shall not affect the rights, existing prior to the attachment, of persons not parties to the suit, nor bar any person holding a decree against the defendant from applying for the sale of the property under attachment in execution of such decree.
article.html:
10Attachment before judgment not to affect rights of strangers, nor bar decree-holder from applying for sale.

Order 38, Rule 10

Attachment before judgment shall not affect the rights, existing prior to the attachment, of persons not parties to the suit, nor bar any person holding a decree against the defendant from applying for the sale of the property under attachment in execution of such decree.
